# Play — Flat-Pack City

- SudokuPad: [Flat-Pack City on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Flat-Pack City on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Both rules are native to f-puzzles: the jigsaw regions are a `region` number (0–8) on every grid cell, and the clues are `skyscraper`
entries. This is the same JSON that Rangsk's solver read when it confirmed uniqueness, and its log names the irregular regions correctly.
I have not opened the links in a browser myself. If an app shows plain 3×3 boxes, it has dropped the regions: use `grid.svg` in this
folder as the reference picture.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (`regions` = 9 strings of region labels, constraints, solution).
